parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The asset information to query. You can set this parameter to an asset name or IP address.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the asset instance.
